title: DAILY EXCELLENCE CHECKLIST — HOW I WILL KEEP EACH COMMITMENT

questions.prompt: I arrived on time and was prepared for duty. How will I keep this?
My grooming, hygiene, and uniform met Zura Spa standards. How will I keep this?
I communicated respectfully with colleagues and management. How will I keep this?
I maintained appropriate client boundaries and confidentiality. How will I keep this?
I followed approved treatment procedures and safety standards. How will I keep this?
I responded to instructions and corrections professionally. How will I keep this?
I assisted my team and completed my responsibilities. How will I keep this?
I reflected honestly on my actions and identified an improvement. How will I keep this?

title: WHAT WILL MY ACTIONS SAY ABOUT ME?

questions.prompt: If nobody knew I had attended this programme, would my conduct alone show that something had changed?
What old habit am I most determined not to return to?
How will I respond when I encounter the same situations that previously challenged me?
Am I prepared to rebuild trust patiently, without demanding immediate recognition?
What am I willing to demonstrate consistently, not merely promise?
